late_v1.what: monthly late-payment forecast for the collections desk
late_v1.formula: late ~ bill_sar + autopay + tariff_band + prior_late_12m + household_size

late_v2.what: the 'improved' late-payment model, reported as fitting almost perfectly
late_v2.formula: late ~ np.log(bill_sar) + autopay + tariff_band + prior_late_12m + household_size + notice_sent

district_leaks.what: district leak rates against main age and pressure

leaks.what: leaks per segment for the renewal plan

consumption.what: monthly consumption in cubic metres for the supply plan
